descriptions.d24d_worm_surrender_8013f348: When the worm graphic has no attachment, loads the SurrenderFlag model, retains its mesh as the attachment (+164), attaches it to the mesh (id 0x804ab328) and selects the resource value (+596 for Prod kinds, +600 otherwise); then plays the idle clip (0x804ab100, control +492) and DrawSurrender (control +472).
